title: 1924 trip to Europe and the first trumpet
summary: On a trip to see his German father's family he hears a ship orchestra and gets a flugelhorn in Bremen, then lessons, drums, organ and records.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Then musically after that, I think it was the normal thing in high school and church--grammar school even--when I was nine years old, the family went to Europe; my father was German and we went to visit his family.

We went on an English ship, the Olympic, as I recall in 1924. I remember being enchanted with the orchestra playing on the ship, and that lead to my getting a trumpet. I'm sure there must have been something before that but I really don't know

what it could have been.
I got a trumpet in Bremen,
Germany. I started with a flugal horn, actu-
ally. It was in the key of F; no, it was not
rotary.

That started me with lessons,
I was playing drums at the same time; there
was an organ around the house that my father
played. There was a phonograph with records
of Caruso--who else at that time--pretty
awful stuff.
